aboutIntro: Software Engineer and full-stack MERN developer with a BSCS foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, databases, and software engineering. I build RESTful APIs and database-backed applications using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and MySQL, with a focus on JWT/RBAC, automated testing, and deterministic recommendation systems.

aboutBullets.text: Pursuing **BS in Computer Science** at Sindh Madressatul Islam University (CGPA 3.7/4.0).
Completed a **MERN Stack Internship** at 10Pearls (10Shine Program).
Certified as an **IBM Full-Stack JavaScript Developer** via Coursera.
Developed 10+ full-stack applications including a **Smart Complaint Management System**.
Proficient in **React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, and Git** workflows.
